title: PTPGE supplier-catalogue/1
description: A maker's own series, grades and models — paper, board, presses, finishing machines, inks — each mapped to the generic terms it embodies. Written and kept current by the maker and published on its own domain at /.well-known/ptpge/catalogue.json (SD-0101). The vocabulary stays free of company and product names because this document exists (SD-0097): a catalogue item is identified by the maker's identity plus the item's id, never by a term. Every vocabulary value is a term URI under https://ptpge.org/v1/ — never a label. No prices. Licence of the schema: CC BY 4.0.

identity.description: The maker's entry in the Suppliers register — the subject of this document.

name.description: The maker's trading name as shown on the register entry.

legalName.description: Registered company name, where it differs.

domain.description: The domain this document is published on. Ownership is proven by the file being there.

logo.description: Optional. Shown on the register entry next to the ptpge-id/1 mark.

makes.description: The vocabulary classes the maker produces for — the same list as the register entry's `makes` (e.g. printing/substrates/sheet-materials/paper, printing/technologies/printing-finishing-equipment/printing-presses).

items.description: The catalogue. Series, grades, shades, models — a flat list with `parent` links; ids are stable and referenced from vendor declarations as {supplier, item}.

modified.description: When this document was last changed; the register's weekly re-check compares it.

generatedBy.description: Which tool wrote the document. Open: an implementation may add its own fields here — nothing under generatedBy is read by the register.

itemId.description: The maker's stable identifier for the item, as a slug path (scandia-2000/white, speedmaster-xl-106). Never renamed; a withdrawn item is marked discontinued.

kind.description: What sort of item: a paper series or grade, a board or roll material, a press, a finishing machine, an ink, a plate.

name.description: The maker's own name for the item — the only place a product name lives.

parent.description: The item this one belongs to (a grade under its series, a shade under its grade).

class.description: The vocabulary class the item embodies: a paper class, a board material, a press type, an equipment class.

terms.description: What the item is, in the vocabulary, per variable: substrate-coating, substrate-finish, substrate-color, substrate-fibre, certification, technology … — only what the maker states or what follows from it.

weightGsm.description: The grammage range of the series, g/m².

shades.description: The maker's named shades (Brick, Vanilla …). The vocabulary shade class goes in `terms` (substrate-color).

sheetSizesMm.description: Sheet sizes stocked, width × height in mm.

maxFormatMm.description: Presses and machines: the largest sheet.

perfecting.description: Presses: prints both sides in one pass.

serves.description: Finishing machines: the completions the model performs.

status.description: current — in the maker's programme; discontinued — withdrawn, kept so old references still resolve.

since.description: When the item entered the programme (year, or year-month).

url.description: The maker's own page for the item.

dataSheet.description: The maker's technical data sheet for the item.

source.description: Where the facts come from (the maker's data sheet, date).
